messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — can we lock a time for a combined post-incident wrap + retro for the DB flapping last Tue? Keep it focused: timeline, RCA, action owners. Options: Thu 10:00, Thu 16:00, Fri 09:00. Which works?
Priya: Thu 10:00 for me. yes please include infra & product.
Linh: I can make Thu 10:00 but will be oncall — whether we run postmortem vs retro depends on scope. I think 45m is enough.
Aaron: Thu 10:00 ok. +1 to 45m. We'll want a quick customer-impact summary and any short-term mitigations.
Samir: can we use this agenda: 1) timeline (10m) 2) root-cause hypotheses & evidence (15m) 3) action owners + priorities (15m) 4) sync on follow-ups + owners (5m).
Naomi: 10:00 works from PM side. please include the exact customer list affected and any comms sent.
Morgan: agenda sounds good. proposing Thu 10:00 then. attendees: oncall (Linh), SRE lead (Aaron), Eng leads (Samir, Morgan), PM (Naomi), Ops (Priya). If anyone else should be there, flag now.
Priya: Ops can join for 10m at start and 10m at end.
Linh: add a short "what we observed" live demo? might be hard during call. Async timeline doc is better.
Morgan: agreed — we'll do async timeline + logs pre-read. please add any snippets you think are important.
Aaron: I'll bring request/latency graphs and error rates.
Samir: I'll take the rollout timeline and the deploy job logs (will paste the key commands).
Naomi: I'll pull the list of impacted customers + comms history.
Morgan: pre-read checklist (please add to the doc before Thu 08:00):
```
- Incident timeline (root cause candidate timestamps)
- Key metrics (errors, latency, throughput)
- Relevant deploys and config changes
- Pager/alert snapshots + runbook steps used
- Customer impact notes and comms
```
Linh: I'll add the runbook steps and the exact alert hits.
Priya: who will own the doc? we should centralize it.
Morgan: I'll create the post-incident doc and link it in the calendar invite. Morgan: filing: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/1765 (placeholder)
Samir: suggestion: during meeting we assign a short-term mitigation owner (P0) and a long-term RCA owner (P1). then we open follow-up cards in the tracker.
Morgan: good call. I'll create a follow-up tracker sheet and add columns: owner, priority (P0/P1), ETA, status, notes.
Naomi: please add a "customer comms" column — I can drive that.
Aaron: small ask: if anyone has logs or queries to run, paste the commands in the doc under "investigations" so we can reproduce offline.
Priya: +1. also please paste the alert query and threshold so we can tune after.
Linh: if someone can't make Thu 10:00, add comments in the doc and nominate delegate. otherwise we should record the session.
Morgan: recording on by default. I'll put "recording" note in the invite.
incident-bot: Incident 1765 (db-flap) was closed at 2025-11-02T15:42:10Z. Link: https://incidents.internal/1765
Naomi: small logistics: can we keep the meeting to 45m? I have a downstream customer sync at 10:45.
Samir: yes 45m hard stop. I'll timebox the RCA section.
Morgan: final attendees (so far): Morgan, Linh (oncall), Aaron (SRE), Samir (eng lead), Naomi (PM), Priya (ops). Recording on. Agenda + pre-read in doc.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll join.
Linh: I'll prepare timeline and post the alert screenshots by Wed EOD.
Aaron: I'll put metrics & graphs by Wed EOD.
Samir: I'll paste deploy logs + tentative RCA notes.
Naomi: I'll compile impacted customer list and past comms.
Morgan: action owners noted pre-meet: Morgan (create doc + invite + tracker), Linh (timeline + alerts), Aaron (metrics), Priya (ops notes + alert query), Samir (deploy logs), Naomi (customer comms). We'll assign P0/P1 in the meeting. If anyone wants to swap tasks, DM me.
Priya: thanks.
Morgan: booking Thu 10:00 — invite sent. If you can't make it, add async notes to the doc and mark as "reviewed".
Naomi: got the invite, thanks.
Samir: thanks — see you Thu.
Morgan: closing thread to avoid extra noise. Add anything important to the doc and I'll surface it in the meeting.
